description: Non-committal buyer — only a soft follow-up commitment, no clean price/timing/competitor objection. Tests whether extraction stays quiet on objections instead of inventing one, since false positives are exactly what erodes manager trust (PRD section 10).

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Hi Fatima, how did the viewing go on Thursday?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: It was fine. I'm still not sure, honestly. I'm looking at a few areas.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Sure, no rush. What other areas are you considering?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Maybe JVC, maybe Business Bay. I haven't really decided anything yet.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Would it help if I sent a few more options in those areas?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Maybe later. I'm not really looking to move fast on this right now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: No problem, I'll check in with you in a few weeks.

next_steps.description: Check in with the customer in a few weeks
